dedupe_keys.name: tudat and tudatpy tu delft astrodynamics toolbox

description: The TU Delft Astrodynamics Toolbox (Tudat) is a set of C++ libraries for astrodynamics and space research, exposed to Python as TudatPy, for simulations, real-data processing and analysis and education. It supports numerical propagation of spacecraft and natural body dynamics, state and parameter estimation from tracking data, mission design and optimisation, with uses ranging from re-entry dynamics to interplanetary missions, and its user guide documents the mathematical models implemented. It covers any orbital regime around Earth and other bodies. It is developed by the Tudat team at Delft University of Technology, open to outside contributions through GitHub, and distributed as a conda package; the documentation announces TudatPy version 1.0, and the conda package was last updated on 23 September 2026. It is free and open source under a BSD-style licence (copyright Delft University of Technology, 2010 to 2025). Caveats: installation relies on conda, Windows builds have limited support from the core developers, and high-fidelity setups need care with environment models. It supports hazard exposure and resilience analysis of satellites, for example orbit decay under changing atmospheric density or conjunction geometry, and design of space infrastructure; a related record is the Orekit space flight dynamics library.
